baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence yas'awna ... mu'ajizina ... muhdaruna links self-directed motion and attempted outstripping to caused presence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposive striving runs within visible signs as an attempted race beyond their reach; the passive final predicate reverses agency, making the runners be brought into the punishment they tried to outrun.

activation_trace.role: Purposive movement toward a sought end makes the opposition an intentional trajectory rather than a static belief.
A visible sign or identifying mark supplies the field through which the hostile movement runs.
Outstripping, escaping pursuit, and being missed supply the competitors' intended advantage.
Painful penalty supplies the destination into which the failed trajectory resolves.
Presence, witnessed arrival, and proximity reverse attempted absence into compelled nearness.

changed_reading.before: People oppose the signs and are punished.
changed_reading.after: Their opposition is a failed escape race: movement meant to outstrip the signs is countered by compulsory arrival inside punishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yas'awna can denote productive effort, while mu'ajizina can project inability onto an opponent and the signs can be deliberately targeted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause depicts more than disbelief: practical effort is organized around the signs to disable, exhaust, or render them ineffective, but the agents of incapacitation are themselves stripped of operative freedom and brought in.

activation_trace.role: Work, earning, and practical disposal make the striving an organized operation with intended effects.
Deliberately targeting an identifying sign makes the signs the chosen object of the operation.
Weakness and inability supply the effect the workers seek to impose on the signs or their bearer.
Caused presence reverses their active project into a condition imposed upon them.

changed_reading.before: They try to get away from the signs.
changed_reading.after: They conduct practical counter-work meant to make the signs fail, only to become the party whose capacity is removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact four-root spine at 34:5 recurs at 34:38, but the later occurrence changes past striving into an ongoing present activity and changes punishment assigned to them into a space in which they are compulsorily present. The refrain therefore traces a campaign from deed to custody.

activation_trace.role: The earlier work-and-effort occurrence establishes the clause as a repeated action formula, not an isolated label.
The same visible-sign branch fixes the target across both occurrences.
The same outstripping and escape image carries the attempted advantage from the opening warning to the focus.
The earlier painful penalty supplies the outcome that the later wording turns into an enclosing location.
Compelled presence marks the later refrain's decisive transition from threatened liability to realized placement.

structural_cues: 34:5 and 34:38 repeat the sequence striving-in-signs, mu'ajizina, and punishment.
34:5 uses past striving and 'for them' punishment; 34:38 uses present striving and 'in' punishment with a passive caused-presence predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence plus aspect and predicate changes; I infer a movement from completed instances through an ongoing campaign to final custody. A live alternative is simple rhetorical repetition without a staged progression.

changed_reading.before: 34:38 independently warns one class of opponents.
changed_reading.after: 34:38 closes a surah-long refrain: the anti-sign campaign remains active until its would-be outstrippers are transferred from acting upon signs to being held inside the consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence places a sign in a dwelling, lays measured safe routes through inhabited space, then turns a demand for greater distance into dispersal and public story, explicitly calling the result signs. Striving 'in Our signs' can thus mean moving inside a sign-saturated world whose resistant actors are converted into further evidence.

activation_trace.role: The visible-mark branch anchors the focus in a world that can display and preserve evidence.
A visible sign located in the people's dwelling makes material habitat, not only recited language, part of the sign field.
Going and flowing along the measured route supplies controlled movement within that field.
Actively producing distance supplies the attempted spatial revision of the given route.
Becoming the talk of people turns the resisting community into a transmissible record.
Tearing and scattering into pieces makes their attempted remapping rebound upon their own social body.
The closing designation as signs explicitly converts the resulting story into visible evidence.

structural_cues: 34:15 says there was a sign in their dwelling; 34:18 twice locates travel 'in it' under measured routing.
At 34:19 they request distance between journeys, are made into stories and torn apart, and the result is named signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embedded signs, routed movement, requested distance, and conversion into stories; I infer that failed resistance becomes self-documenting evidence. A live alternative is that the Saba account remains only a parallel historical example and does not redefine the focus preposition.

changed_reading.before: The agents operate against signs treated as external objects.
changed_reading.after: They operate inside a world already structured as signs, and their attempt to alter its routes is itself absorbed into the sign system as a cautionary record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The leader-follower dispute reveals organized redirection: status holders command disbelief, weaker followers describe continuous night-and-day plotting, and clear signs are counter-labeled as fabrication and magic. The plural strivers are therefore readable as a social apparatus that administers obstruction, not merely parallel individuals fleeing privately.

activation_trace.role: Office, oversight, and agency over a people let striving denote organized administration of a collective course.
Denunciation carried to authority supplies a political channel through which signs or their bearer can be attacked.
Turning and diverting others supplies the apparatus's practical blocking function.
Demand backed by obligation supplies the vertical command linking leaders to followers.
A collar that binds the limb materializes the eventual loss of mobility produced by the same coercive network.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the reputational counter-label used against the recited signs.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between those made weak and those acting great, with night-and-day plotting and commands to disbelieve.
34:43 answers clearly recited signs with coordinated claims that the messenger blocks ancestral worship and that the message is fabrication or magic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hierarchy, commands, diversion, persistent plotting, and repeated counter-labels; I infer a coordinated obstruction system behind the focus plural. A live alternative is that the speeches expose influence without making every focus actor part of an organized apparatus.

changed_reading.before: The strivers are individual skeptics trying to outrun evidence.
changed_reading.after: The strivers can be status-bearing operators who direct people away, circulate disabling labels, and use authority to make the signs socially ineffective before their own movement is bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame denies that accumulated wealth and descendants purchase privileged nearness, assigns secure chambers by faithful work, places the hostile strivers inside punishment, then describes expenditure as replaceable. This converts attempted escape into a failed economy of leverage: possessed resources cannot produce safe access or immunity, while the focus agents receive coerced proximity instead.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning let the striving participate in the surrounding economy of action, assets, and return.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the claimed leverage behind expected immunity.
Penalty is explicitly denied by the wealthy speakers, exposing the immunity claim that the focus overturns.
Favored nearness to a ruler supplies the status-access that wealth and children fail to obtain.
Nearness as rank or station specifies the privileged proximity being falsely priced.
Money leaving through expenditure supplies the authorized counter-economy of release rather than hoarded leverage.
One thing replacing another supplies return without making possession itself a source of immunity.
Compelled nearness answers the failed attempt to buy favored nearness with an imposed and punitive presence.

structural_cues: 34:35 claims greater wealth and children entail no punishment; 34:37 denies that either brings anyone near and contrasts secure chambers with the focus's punishment.
34:36 and 34:39 repeat expansion and restriction of provision around the focus, while 34:39 adds expenditure and replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immunity boast, denied status-nearness, contrasting destinations, and an expenditure-return sequence; I infer that the focus attacks resource-based leverage as an escape technology. A live alternative is a simple contrast of moral groups with no economic coloring of mu'ajizina.

changed_reading.before: They seek escape through speed or direct opposition alone.
changed_reading.after: Their striving can include deploying wealth, descendants, and earned capacity as leverage for exemption; those resources fail to bring privileged nearness, and they are instead brought near inside punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering for a truth-opening judgment, being held before the Lord, returning accusations to one another, and being driven together all thicken muhdarun into compelled appearance within adjudication. The same assembly nullifies the social support on which organized opposition relied.

activation_trace.role: Appearing in dispute and contest before a ruler supplies the procedural force of being made present.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the compulsory assembly in which the parties can no longer remain apart.
Opening what is closed by judgment supplies adjudication rather than mere physical congregation.
Fixed remaining in one place supplies the held posture of the assembled opponents.
Returning speech and answers supplies the adversarial exchange conducted while they are held.
Driving and gathering a group toward one destination supplies the coercive transport implicit in muhdarun.
The loss of benefit between parties removes the alliances and patrons that might have altered the proceeding.

structural_cues: 34:26 promises gathering followed by a truth-based opening between the parties; 34:31 shows them held before their Lord and exchanging blame.
34:40 gathers all together, and 34:42 denies reciprocal benefit or harm immediately before the command to taste punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, judicial opening, detention, exchanged pleas, coercive gathering, and failed support; I infer that the focus's caused presence anticipates a compelled hearing and sentence. A live alternative is that muhdarun denotes eschatological presence generally without a courtroom mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They are simply transported into a punitive place.
changed_reading.after: They are compelled into an adjudicative assembly where their counter-claims and support networks are exposed, held, and made unable to avert the sentence they inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: After clear signs are verbally disabled as fabrication or magic, truth is depicted as a force hurled into the field and falsehood as unable even to initiate or repeat an act. The incapacity that mu'ajizina tries to impose therefore rebounds: the signs are active, while the antagonistic program is the inoperative side.

activation_trace.role: Weakness and inability anchor the question of which side is actually rendered ineffective.
Clearly displayed marks identify what the speakers attempt to neutralize through hostile relabeling.
Hurling and casting far gives truth projectile agency rather than leaving the signs as passive targets.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the durable content carried by that active projection.
Opening or initiating an act supplies the first operation explicitly denied to falsehood.
Idleness and loss of useful work make falsehood, not the signs, the operationally disabled party.
Returning after departure supplies the repeated operation also denied to falsehood.

structural_cues: 34:43 meets clearly recited signs with claims of fabrication and manifest magic.
34:48-49 moves from truth being hurled to truth arriving and falsehood neither beginning nor repeating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted verbal neutralization, active truth, and falsehood's lack of operations; I infer a deliberate reversal of the focus's incapacity contest. A live alternative is that the ending announces victory without specifically relocating the ajz image.

changed_reading.before: The opponents may appear capable of making the signs fail.
changed_reading.after: Their campaign reveals its own incapacity: truth enters with force, while falsehood cannot start, sustain, or rerun an effective operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first denies that anything can be absent from knowledge and fixes an appointment that cannot be shifted; its close then denies escape, makes seizure occur from near, makes desired reaching impossible from far, and installs a barrier. Mu'ajizina and muhdarun thus form a complete topology of failed evasion: neither time, distance, nor access offers an outside.

activation_trace.role: Directed movement supplies the attempted path out of accountability.
Outstripping pursuit and escaping reach supply the intended spatial and temporal result.
Distance, absence, and slipping beyond reach are denied at the surah's opening, closing the epistemic route of escape.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the deadline that cannot be advanced or deferred.
Failure to attain or catch is explicitly negated, directly cancelling the hoped-for outstripping.
Seizure and captivity supply the concrete coercion behind being brought in.
Nearness contrary to distance collapses the imagined gap at the moment of capture.
Reaching by extending toward something supplies the access now unavailable to them.
Distance opposed to nearness locates the desired recovery beyond effective reach.
A barrier separating two things seals the final route between the agents and what they desire.
Compelled presence is the positive endpoint produced after every avenue of absence is closed.

structural_cues: 34:3 couples the Hour's certain coming with nothing, however small, being absent; 34:30 denies moving the appointment backward or forward.
34:51-54 proceeds through no escape, seizure from a near place, failed reaching from a far place, and a barrier between them and desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed time and a near/far/barrier sequence; I infer that these distributed constraints specify the geometry of mu'ajizina and the causation in muhdarun. A live alternative is that the ending only illustrates the punishment after the focus without unpacking its motion language.

changed_reading.before: The verse says generally that escape will fail.
changed_reading.after: The whole surah closes every coordinate of escape: nothing can remain absent, the time cannot shift, distance collapses at capture, recovery becomes too remote, and a barrier makes compulsory presence irreversible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the self-purchase branch of striving is a specialized manumission sense, not the ordinary lexical rendering here. It remains anchored in yas'awna and is activated by wealth, spending, shackles, and compulsory presence; downstream prose should present it only as a juridical-economic analogy, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B005 branch of س ع ي lets yas'awna evoke labor undertaken to purchase release, while muhdarun supplies the opposite condition of non-release.

activation_trace.role: An enslaved person's earning toward the price of freedom supplies the model of effort intended to buy release.
A collar binding the limb makes failed release materially legible as restraint.
Accumulated wealth supplies the imagined purchase price or reserve behind the immunity claim.
Compelled presence supplies the failure of self-release and the creditor-like enforcement of the outcome.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the contrasting authorized use of resources rather than a private ransom from accountability.

changed_reading.before: The strivers spend effort to defeat or escape the signs.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble debt-bound laborers trying to earn their own release with accumulated means, only to find that accountability cannot be bought off and compulsory custody remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates specialized competitive-running and animal-driving branches around ordinary theological language. It remains tightly anchored in yas'awna, mu'ajizina, muhdarun, and the closing no-escape capture; downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic overlay rather than imply literal animals or a technical race.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three focus roots can align as competitive striving, attempted outstripping, and being driven into motion, allowing the verse's agency reversal to be pictured as a race that changes handlers.

activation_trace.role: Competitive striving in which one runner overcomes another supplies the initial race.
Getting ahead and escaping pursuit supplies the racers' hoped-for win condition.
Driving a mount into a run supplies the reversal in which the self-directed racers become the driven party.
The explicit denial of missed capture closes the possibility that the racers remain beyond reach.
Bringing a horse near in its run provides a branch-distant but coherent image for the sudden near-place seizure.

changed_reading.before: The opponents run a race they cannot win.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic image, the race changes control: those trying to outstrip the signs are themselves driven to the punitive finish and taken within reach.

strongest_changes: The duplicate 34:5 formula turns 34:38 from an isolated threat into the custody endpoint of a sustained anti-sign campaign.
The Saba route and the immediate wealth-nearness frame show that opposition operates inside signs and cannot purchase an outside or privileged exemption.
The truth/falsehood and 34:51-54 endings reverse incapacity onto the antagonists and close time, distance, access, and desire as escape routes.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence linked motion, political obstruction, economic leverage, adjudication, and self-documenting signs while preserving them as distinct mechanisms rather than one blended interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Mu'ajizina can still weight either competitive evasion or active incapacitation; the packet supports both without forcing a choice.
The adjudicative, self-ransom, and driven-race images are branch-grounded but should remain qualified because their specialized senses are more distant than the core escape reading.
